blurb: Guests rent various watercraft such as party barges, pontoon boats, ski boats, and jet skis. Party barges come with a captain and crew, and include amenities like Bluetooth speakers, noodles, restrooms, and BBQ griddles. Rentals include safety equipment and optional add-ons like Paradise Pads and water slides.
